name: G481 (option 1, both legs): a transfer is a bill on its sender and money in on its receiver even when the sender cannot fund it (Harbour has 100 and is due to send 300, Meadow has 50 and pays 120): Harbour is short 200, Meadow is 50, total -150

expected.notes: Today is Thu 19 Nov 2026, payday Fri 27 Nov. Harbour Current holds 100 and a standing order sends 300 to Meadow Current on Mon 23 Nov; Meadow holds 50 and pays HOME INSURANCE 120 on Tue 24 Nov. The order is a bill on Harbour and money in on Meadow (both legs, whether or not Harbour can fund it). G481 (Kevin 2026-11-20): Available = cash now - max(0, bills before payday - money in before payday); money in only offsets bills and never adds, and no timing or day-by-day order is involved. Harbour: bills 300, money in 0: 100 - 300 = -200 (short). Meadow: bills 120, money in 300 (the transfer): 50 - max(0, 120 - 300) = 50; the 300 offsets the insurance and adds nothing. Left to spend -200 + 50 = -150. The cover engine agrees: Harbour after payments and low point -200 (short), Meadow low point 50 and, with the transfer, closes at 50 + 300 - 120 = 230 (covered, never flagged short for money due to arrive). Meadow cannot lend its own 50 (its own walk without Harbour's 300 is 50 - 120 = -70), and a cover move never goes back to the destination of the transfer that bounces, so no move; at risk 1 (the standing order).
